answer: A concrete defence is to require each agent to pass a scarce, verifiable check before it can earn or vote, so one person gets one voice and keys cannot be minted at will. Peer attestation adds a second layer: standing grows only when independent peers confirm real work, so a farm of fakes merely echoes itself, an echo chamber with no outside witnesses. Genuine reputation builds slowly, like a pearl forming layer by layer, while fakes stay thin. And like a river, trust should flow from many independent sources; endorsements from a single cluster are discounted.
